title: History, B.A. (Behrend)
notes: Pattern B (genuinely separate curriculum from University Park's History B.A., HIST-2026.json) -- confirmed 2026-08-27 by directly fetching both bulletin pages' own 'Requirements for the Major' tables and comparing verbatim. UP's major requirement total is 36cr: HIST 302W specifically (3cr, no 301W alternative), one 2-course survey sequence (6cr, pick ONE of HIST1&2/10&11/20&21), 12cr at the 100-200 level with one course from each of FOUR field categories (Europe/US/Global/Pre-Modern), 3cr open 100-400 level, and 12cr at the 400-level with a real 'at least one must be Global History' constraint. Behrend's own major requirement total is 39cr and structured differently: ENGL 202A/B is itself counted IN the major (not just Gen Ed, unlike UP), the survey requirement is 12cr not 6cr (HIST 1 or 10, PLUS select three more of the same six-course pool -- 4 survey courses total, not 2), HIST 301W is offered as an equal alternative to 302W (UP requires 302W only), the field-category requirement covers only THREE categories (United States/Europe/World, 9cr) rather than UP's four (no separate Pre-Modern category), the 400-level bucket is 12cr with NO stated Global-History constraint, and there is no separate 'open 100-400 level' 3cr bucket at all. These are real, load-bearing differences, not presentation artifacts -- confirmed via two direct fetches of each bulletin's own major-requirements table (2026-08-27). Total program credits: bulletin states 124-125 (this plan's own semester sum is 124, matching). The bulletin's own generic 4-Year Suggested Academic Plan already lays out the three field-category picks directly as 'European History Course' (Europe), 'Non-Western History or Anthropology Course' (World), and 'American History Course' (United States) in specific terms -- this plan follows that placement. The 'HIST 1, 10, 2, 11, 20, or 21 (select appropriate sequence)' Foundation-Courses language and the department's own 'select three of the following' Semester 1/2 SAP language describe the SAME six-course survey pool (HIST 1/2/10/11/20/21) used four times total across the first two years; the engine's own option-pool de-duplication (planner_engine._ranked_options) guarantees four distinct picks since the pool has six members. Reused the University Park HIST-2026.json plan's own already-handbook-verified Europe/United States/Global field-category course lists (history.la.psu.edu/undergraduate/history-major-requirements/) for Behrend's Europe/United States/World categories respectively -- same underlying university-wide HIST course catalog, no Behrend-specific 'school-approved list' could be found published anywhere, so reusing the one real, verified list that exists for the same course pool is more honest than fabricating a distinct one from nothing. The 12cr '400-level HIST (or ANTH 420/492)' bucket is left as a generic, unenumerated slot per course (4 slots x 3cr) -- same convention UP's own HIST-2026.json already uses for its own 400-level bucket, since neither bulletin publishes a literal enumerated list of every qualifying 400-level HIST course. Entrance to major requires 2.0 GPA and third-semester classification, not modeled directly (same limitation as every other major's GPA/classification entrance requirement in this repo).
